cluster_stories.title: China Will Open Its Market to AI Chips From US, Nvidia’s CEO Says
cluster_stories.summary: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, speaking days after he joined President Donald Trump’s summit in China, said he expects Chinese authorities will eventually allow the import of artificial intelligence chips from the US.
cluster_stories.headline: NVIDIA CEO: China Will Open Market to US AI Chips

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek and China’s AI boom are increasingly powered by state money
cluster_stories.summary: Government-linked investors in China went from backing fewer than 10 AI deals annually before 2018 to more than 140 in 2025, reshaping who controls the future of AI.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA'S AI BOOM Now 70% STATE-FUNDED... DeepSeek Backed by Government

cluster_stories.title: China banned Nvidia’s gaming chip during Jensen Huang’s visit
cluster_stories.summary: Beijing aims to support domestic players including Huawei and Cambricon as they catch up to US rivals
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BANS NVIDIA CHIPS DURING HUANG VISIT

cluster_stories.title: Baidu AI Sales Eclipse Waning Legacy Ads for the First Time
cluster_stories.summary: Baidu Inc. posted a better-than-feared 1% drop in revenue after growth in nascent AI businesses offset a steady decline in traditional internet revenue, buying the search leader time to catch rivals such as Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. in the post-ChatGPT era.
cluster_stories.headline: BAIDU AI Sales Eclipse Legacy Ads for First Time

cluster_stories.title: Airbnb’s Chesky Says US ‘Misunderstanding’ Use of Chinese Open-Source AI Models
cluster_stories.summary: Airbnb Inc. Chief Executive Officer Brian Chesky defended his company’s use of Chinese artificial intelligence models, saying US lawmakers who worry Chinese firms can access Americans’ user data are “misunderstanding” the technology.
cluster_stories.headline: Airbnb CEO Defends Chinese AI Models Amid US Backlash
